summary: Wide dirt verge beside bush, nearest home 33 m away.
reasons: Wide dirt verge off the lane

best_section.where: Broseley Road, west-side verge between the bush edge and the lane, uphill of the junction

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind, park opposite; nearest dwelling 33 m away at the south end.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt and grass strip, several metres wide, meets the road edge, so a van can pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Through road with painted lines; passing traffic is a noise flag only, as the van stands off the lane.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles seen on the verge.

flags: Traffic noise from the through road
sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy shades the bush side; verge gets some sun from the east and south.
